paragraphs.text: The Sliver Legion is a legendary sliver swarm from Dominaria .

The Sliver Legion debuted in Future Sight . They are a swarm of slivers seen during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria . They appeared as a clicking, chittering group of different colored slivers associated with all colors of mana. Some of the slivers had blue scales, others had red scales, with at least one being white. It was said that inside the Legion, a unique young mind grew more aware.
